description: Reviewed capture-qualified quotations accepted by N4 (naming-candidate.py compare --reviewed-quotations). Each record is accepted only where it occurs, with this before/after spelling, pre-resolving to map_old, and with the after spelling exactly map_old's fully qualified new name; an unlisted occurrence fails and an unused record is stale. Master decision 2026-11-16 (jsn-u9, G0a).

quotations.reason: ssz_progressive_container quotes the word type inside namespace JauneConsensus, which has its own U256 (pyspec uint256); the names-only respelling U256 would denote that type, so the rename qualifies it as Jaune.U256. The quotation pre-resolves to Jaune.B256 before and Jaune.U256 after (same declaration under the map); the macro reads its own arguments with getId, not this identifier.
